slot_id_policy: Fixed zero-padded provisioned indices; never computer names or operation IDs
status_query: Read-only authoritative snapshot; no queue slot consumed
control_capacity: Dedicated cancel and acknowledgement records per provisioned target, independent of work ingress saturation
provider_requests: One strict requiredRevisionId document batch plus authoritative readback; no unconditional authority mutation
release_gate: Later protocol, adapter, timing, commissioning, GUI and real-provider acceptance required
